eval: (async () => { const d = (await (await fetch('/api/device', {headers: {connection: 'close'}})).json()).data; if (d.lastResult) throw Error('auto_pull must be 0 for this recipe'); const serial = d.device.serial; const sizes = { 'REC20261020_103000.mp3': 2097152, 'REC20261020_143000.mp3': 1572864, 'REC20261021_090000.mp3': 204800 }; const names = Object.keys(sizes); const r = await fetch('/api/ingest/manifest', {method: 'POST', headers: {'content-type': 'application/json', connection: 'close'}, body: JSON.stringify({serial, entries: names.map((name) => ({ name, sizeBytes: sizes[name] }))})}); const body = await r.json(); if (!body.ok || body.data.accepted !== 3) throw Error('Manifest not registered: ' + JSON.stringify(body)); return { serial, ids: body.data.ids }; })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pulllist li')]; const small = rows.find((li) => li.innerText.includes('REC20261021_090000.mp3')); if (!small || small.innerText.includes('无线快传')) throw Error('A small recording must not be marked for the hotspot'); return rows.filter((li) => li.innerText.includes('无线快传')).length; })()

(() => { const row = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pulllist li')].find((li) => li.innerText.includes('REC20261021_090000.mp3')); if (!row) throw Error('Row missing'); row.querySelector('button').click(); return 'pull one'; })()

(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pulllist li')].map((li) => li.innerText); const big = rows.filter((t) => t.includes('无线快传')); if (rows.length !== 2 || big.length !== 2) throw Error('Large single-item syncs should be marked: ' + JSON.stringify(rows)); if (!document.querySelector('.pulllist__hint')?.innerText.includes('暂时断开外网')) throw Error('Missing offline hint under the list'); return rows; })()

(async () => { const items = (await (await fetch('/api/recordings', {headers: {connection: 'close'}})).json()).data.items; const pending = items.filter((item) => item.status === 'pending'); const ready = items.filter((item) => item.status === 'ready'); if (pending.length !== 2 || ready.length !== 1) throw Error('Unexpected statuses: ' + JSON.stringify(items.map((item) => [item.filename, item.status]))); sessionStorage.setItem('pendingId', String(pending[0].id)); sessionStorage.setItem('readyId', String(ready[0].id)); location.hash = '#/rec/' + pending[0].id; return { pending: pending.map((item) => item.id), ready: ready[0].id }; })()

(() => { const primaries = [...document.querySelectorAll('.detail__actions .btn--primary, .detail__actions button.primary')]; const labels = [...document.querySelectorAll('.detail__actions button')].map((b) => b.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean); if (!labels.includes('开始转录')) throw Error('Missing primary 开始转录: ' + JSON.stringify(labels)); for (const extra of ['重新转录', '重新归类', 'AI 归类', '从设备拉取音频']) if (labels.includes(extra)) throw Error('Unexpected header action ' + extra + ': ' + JSON.stringify(labels)); const crumb = document.querySelector('nav[aria-label="当前位置"]'); if (crumb?.querySelector('a')?.innerText.trim() !== '录音') throw Error('Missing breadcrumb'); return { labels, primaries: primaries.length }; })()

(() => { const link = document.querySelector('a.calendar-recording-button[href="#/rec/' + sessionStorage.getItem('readyId') + '"]'); if (!link) throw Error('Recording not on the 2026-10-21 calendar day'); link.click(); return link.getAttribute('href'); })()
(() => { if (!location.hash.startsWith('#/calendar')) throw Error('Back should return to the calendar, got ' + location.hash); return location.hash; })()

(async () => { const p = await (await fetch('/api/settings', {method: 'PATCH', headers: {'content-type': 'application/json', connection: 'close'}, body: JSON.stringify({values: {auto_pull: '1'}})})).json(); if (!p.ok) throw Error('PATCH failed'); const d = await (await fetch('/api/device/disconnect', {method: 'POST', headers: {'content-type': 'application/json', connection: 'close'}, body: '{}'})).json(); if (!d.ok) throw Error('disconnect failed: ' + JSON.stringify(d)); return d.data.connection.state; })()

eval: (async () => { const d = (await (await fetch('/api/device', {headers: {connection: 'close'}})).json()).data; if (d.connection.state !== 'disconnected' || !d.syncPlan?.willGoOffline || !d.autoConnect.syncOnConnect) throw Error('Unexpected preview: ' + JSON.stringify({ state: d.connection.state, syncPlan: d.syncPlan, auto: d.autoConnect })); const p = await (await fetch('/api/settings', {method: 'PATCH', headers: {'content-type': 'application/json', connection: 'close'}, body: JSON.stringify({values: {auto_pull: '0'}})})).json(); if (!p.ok) throw Error('restore auto_pull failed'); return d.syncPlan; })()
